mapper.select: SELECT rf.form_rule_code, rf.field_code, rf.field_name, rfv.validator_type, rfv.template_code, IFNULL( rvt.validator_pattern, rfv.validator_pattern ) validator_pattern, IFNULL( rvt.validator_function, rfv.validator_function ) validator_function, rfv.msg_template FROM mdm_form_rule_field rf LEFT JOIN mdm_form_rule_field_validator rfv ON rfv.form_rule_code = rf.form_rule_code AND rfv.field_code = rf.field_code AND rfv.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN mdm_form_rule_validator_template rvt ON rvt.template_code = rfv.template_code AND rvt.deleted = 0 WHERE rf.deleted = 0 AND rf.form_rule_code = #{formRuleCode} ORDER BY rf.sort ASC, rf.id ASC, rfv.sort ASC, rfv.id ASC

SELECT rf.form_rule_code, rf.field_code, rf.field_name, rfv.validator_type, rfv.template_code, IFNULL( rvt.validator_pattern, rfv.validator_pattern ) validator_pattern, IFNULL( rvt.validator_function, rfv.validator_function ) validator_function, rfv.msg_template FROM mdm_form_rule r LEFT JOIN mdm_form_rule_field rf ON rf.form_rule_code = r.form_rule_code AND rf.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN mdm_form_rule_field_validator rfv ON rfv.form_rule_code = rf.form_rule_code AND rfv.field_code = rf.field_code AND rfv.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN mdm_form_rule_validator_template rvt ON rvt.template_code = rfv.template_code AND rvt.deleted = 0 WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND r.api_method = #{apiMethod} AND r.api_uri = #{apiUri} ORDER BY rf.sort ASC, rf.id ASC, rfv.sort ASC, rfv.id ASC

SELECT rfv.form_rule_code, rfv.field_code, rfv.validator_type, IFNULL(rft.validator_pattern, rfv.validator_pattern) validator_pattern, IFNULL(rft.validator_function, rfv.validator_function) validator_function, rfv.template_code, rfv.msg_template FROM mdm_form_rule_field_validator rfv LEFT JOIN mdm_form_rule_validator_template rft ON rft.template_code = rfv.template_code AND rft.deleted = 0 WHERE rfv.deleted = 0 ORDER BY rfv.sort ASC, rfv.id ASC
